Topic 1.4: Effective LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Effective LISTENING
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do we LISTENING communication learner should be able to: Simon says, in small groups communicate?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. listen with increased attention to  Learners engage in story telling indigenous 2 lessons rhymes, songs, conversations and  Learners listen to audio or audiovisual languag
2. listen to experiences of others and  Learners listen and pick out respond appropriately to the vocabulary from material listened to feelings and ideas expressed  Learners listen to daily announcements

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Effective LISTENING

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Effective LISTENING

Teach
• Focus skill: listen with increased attention to  Learners engage in story telling indigenous 2 lessons rhymes, songs, conversations and  Learners listen to audio or audiovisual languag.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Effective LISTENING.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Effective LISTENING
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we LISTENING communication learner should be able to: Simon says, in small groups communicate?
2. How do we b) listen and communicate effectively  Learners are provided with communicate?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
